AUTH-007 owns ModelConfig's only imported consumer. The helper first performs strict JSON.parse, then two string-preserving regex passes for // line comments and trailing commas, then retries parsing. It does not strip block comments and propagates the second parse failure. Direct tests cover strict URL strings, both permissive constructs and invalid JSON.
